text: {"lessons":["Selling B, E, and C at gains felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; weigh each holding’s outlook and my plan before locking it in.","My average cost is not a reason to keep a losing position or sell a winning one. I should judge each stock on its prospects, not on whether selling feels like admitting a mistake.","The account moved up and down while I mostly held. I should stay patient and avoid trading just because of short-term fluctuations, while still reviewing my positions deliberately."]}
